prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web creator product catalog decision comp, first viewport, 16:9 landscape
Primary request: Design an unmistakable operational marketplace catalog screen for SHUAMO titled "Discover products". Structure first, in this exact visual order: (1) a slim fixed workspace navigation rail on the left with SHUAMO wordmark and compact labeled destinations; (2) a large but restrained page heading "Discover products" with one short factual helper line; (3) a strong fixed product-type navigation band spanning the content area with "All products", "Perfume", "Candles", "Sets" and a clearly active category; (4) a practical control row with a search field "Search products", compact "Sort: Newest" control and compact outline "Filters" trigger; (5) a spacious responsive CATEGORY GALLERY of exactly four image-led product cards using varied but disciplined editorial crops, with one card subtly larger/featured but never becoming a marketing hero; (6) refined paging visible along the lower edge and the small disclosure "Illustrative catalog data".
Input images: Image 1 is an identity reference only. Carry over its paper-white ground, ink-black typography, signal indigo #4436F5, Geist-like sans and mono figures, fine neutral rules, modest 8–12px corners, restrained elevation, tabular money, generous whitespace, and calm provenance-led product character. Do not copy Image 1's content, sections, card layouts, public header, or long-page composition.
Subject/content: Four premium editorial product photographs contained inside real product cards: amber perfume bottle in warm stone light; citrus perfume bottle against pale lemon paper; amber candle in smoked glass; discovery gift set in a quiet top-down crop. Each card must visibly pair the photograph with structured offer metadata: brand, product type, product name, price, commission, and a brief terms cue. Use these factual seed values where rendered: "Aromashop"; "Amber perfume 100ml"; "250.00 ₾"; "12.5% of net"; "Citrus perfume 50ml"; "145.00 ₾"; "10% of net"; "Amber candle"; "80.00 ₾"; "8.00 ₾ per sale"; "Retired discovery set"; "60.00 ₾"; "6.00 ₾ per sale"; mark the retired item "Archived — terms unavailable". Terms cues for active items may use the factual action language "Create link at this rate". Keep commercial values in compact mono. No sales, ratings, popularity, creator counts, conversion numbers, customer proof, or performance claims.
Composition/framing: Full-bleed application viewport only, no browser chrome or device frame. Approximate 1440x900 desktop proportions. Left rail occupies about 13% width; main content uses a disciplined 12-column grid and roomy outer padding. Gallery imagery occupies most of each card while offer metadata stays easy to compare. Ensure all four cards are at least substantially visible in the first viewport; lower paging sits at the bottom edge. One first card may span two columns while the other three remain visually balanced. This must read as a working product discovery UI, not a poster, ad, campaign, moodboard, landing-page hero, or retail storefront.
Style/medium: realistic production-grade SaaS/product UI screenshot with refined editorial product photography inside cards; premium, modern, calm, factual.
Color palette: paper white #FFFFFF, ink #111318, pale slate #F7F8FA/#EFF1F5, hairline #8E95A3 used lightly, single signal indigo #4436F5 for the active category and one primary interaction only.
Typography: clean Geist-like sans for interface hierarchy; compact Geist Mono-like numerals for all GEL prices and commission figures; high legibility and credible UI scale.
Constraints: exactly four product cards; brand/product type/name/price/commission/terms cue visibly associated on every card; all required navigation and control regions present; paging and "Illustrative catalog data" visible; accessible contrast; precise alignment; refined spacing; only one indigo decision signal.
Avoid: gradients, glassmorphism, blur decoration, random bright colors, oversized marketing hero, giant headline, fake metrics, fake claims, ratings, badges without words, excessive pills, nested cards, hard shadows, browser/device frame, poster-like layout, collage, dashboard charting, mobile layout, watermark, reference-content leakage.
